Hi — Fahad here, AI engineer in Dhaka.

I visited rejuvenatebd.com and was impressed — 4.9★ rating, 3+ branches (Gulshan 2 basement + ladies-only Level 1, Dhanmondi, Uttara), and the 'Private female-only styling chambers' positioning is genuinely smart for the Dhaka market. The Hair Revival package at ৳4,500 and Premium Grooming at ৳4,500 are premium-tier pricing.

But here's what I noticed: booking is phone-only (+880 1406-699612). For a salon with 3 branches and a 4.9★ reputation, that means your front desk is spending time on scheduling instead of client experience. And with ladies-only and unisex branches, the booking logic isn't simple — you need to route clients to the right branch and the right wing automatically.

I built an AI booking agent that handles WhatsApp/Instagram DM enquiries 24/7 — it asks what service they want, recommends the right branch (ladies-only vs unisex), shows available slots, and confirms the booking. It also sends appointment reminders and follow-up review requests, which is how you turn that 4.9★ into 5.0★.

Happy to show you a working demo in 15 minutes. No commitment.

Best,
Fahad
